sections.basis: IRPEF taxable income, per year (bands as published by MEF; see the special rules)
sections.note: Rates apply to each band of income.

rows.label: Special rules (disposizioni particolari)
rows.value: Income up to €28,000 with at least two dependent children: €30 credit per dependent child; income up to €28,000: €40 per dependent child with a disability (Law 104/1992). No refund where the credit exceeds the surcharge.

rows.label: Legal basis (norme di riferimento)

Art. 1, comma 2, Legge 30 dicembre 2021, n. 234. Art. 1 della L.R. 28 dicembre 2021, n. 31. Art. 1 della L.R. 30 marzo 2022, n. 7.
